goal: Populate README.md with an OSS-style onboarding page (pitch, pre-release banner, quickstart, docs links, contributing, license) and add a minimal CONTRIBUTING.md stub that the README links to.

references: .workflow/specs/00007-FEATURE-readme-onboarding.md -- authoritative spec; mirror its required section list, ordering, and acceptance grep targets.
pyproject.toml `description` field -- source of the README's one-line pitch (do not contradict it).

src/flywheel/workflow.py -- canonical `python -m flywheel.workflow run` CLI shape; the copy-pastable invocation in the README must use the real subcommand and any required flags (see the `run` subparser in `_build_parser`).
constraints: README section order: title + one-line pitch, pre-release/WIP banner, Quickstart, Documentation, Contributing, License.

Quickstart shows, in order: (a) the Python 3.13 requirement, (b) `uv sync` install, (c) a fenced ```json Task block inlined in the README, (d) the `python -m flywheel.workflow run` invocation with whatever flags a copy-paste needs to avoid an immediate CLI usage error.

The inline Task JSON in the Quickstart MUST validate cleanly through `flywheel.loaders.load_task_file` -- a grader extracts the first ```json fenced block in README.md and feeds it through the loader.
Repo URL used in clone instructions is exactly `https://github.com/johnayoung/flywheel`.
CONTRIBUTING.md is a stub (~30 lines) covering: `uv sync` on Python 3.13, `uv run pytest`, the phrase `Conventional Commits`, and a link to `docs/vision.md`.
No LICENSE file in this task -- README states `License: TBD`.
No emojis anywhere in README.md or CONTRIBUTING.md (project-wide rule in CLAUDE.md).
No badges, no `` tags, no `![...]` images, no `[![...]` shields in README.md or CONTRIBUTING.md.
Do not embed full doc bodies in README -- link to docs/*.md with a one-line description per link.
Commit the changes with a Conventional Commits message using the `docs:` prefix before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not create a LICENSE file.
Do not add a project-layout / directory-tree section to the README.
Do not edit existing files under docs/.
Do not add CI, version, or license badges.
Do not add tutorials, architecture deep-dives, or design rationale to the README -- those belong in docs/.
edge_cases: Reader is on Python < 3.13 -- the Python 3.13 requirement must be stated before any install command runs.
Reader does not have `uv` installed -- link to the official uv install docs rather than reproducing them.
Reader runs the quickstart from a directory that is not the repo root -- state that paths are relative to the repo root.

graders.name: readme-keywords
graders.run: grep -Eq 'pre-release|WIP' README.md && grep -q 'uv sync' README.md && grep -q 'python -m flywheel.workflow run' README.md && grep -q 'CONTRIBUTING.md' README.md && grep -q 'License: TBD' README.md && grep -q 'github.com/johnayoung/flywheel' README.md

graders.name: readme-doc-links
graders.run: grep -q 'docs/vision.md' README.md && grep -q 'docs/task-schema.md' README.md && grep -q 'docs/task-lifecycle.md' README.md && grep -q 'docs/loop.md' README.md && grep -q 'docs/strategy.md' README.md

graders.name: contributing-keywords
graders.run: grep -q 'uv sync' CONTRIBUTING.md && grep -q 'uv run pytest' CONTRIBUTING.md && grep -q 'Conventional Commits' CONTRIBUTING.md && grep -q 'docs/vision.md' CONTRIBUTING.md

graders.name: no-emoji
graders.run: uv run python -c 'import re, pathlib, sys; pat = re.compile("[\U0001F300-\U0001FAFF\U0001F600-\U0001F64F\U0001F900-\U0001F9FF\U00002700-\U000027BF]"); bad = [(f, m.group(), m.start()) for f in ("README.md","CONTRIBUTING.md") for m in pat.finditer(pathlib.Path(f).read_text())]; sys.exit(0 if not bad else "emoji found: " + repr(bad))'

graders.name: readme-quickstart-json
graders.run: sed -n '/^```json$/,/^```$/{//!p;}' README.md > .readme-task-block.json && test -s .readme-task-block.json && uv run python -c 'from flywheel.loaders import load_task_file; load_task_file(".readme-task-block.json")' && rm -f .readme-task-block.json
